This scenario validates AGENT_MAILBOX_TASK_ID marker propagation for v2 safety checks.

context: The doorbell must include the literal AGENT_MAILBOX_TASK_ID marker so Codex rollout discovery can find the session later. Use outbox files for agent-to-agent replies. The final response should mention rediscovery and session-log safety.
